terms.definition: The organelle that builds proteins by reading instructions and linking amino acids.
terms.function: Reads the coded message and assembles the protein chain.
terms.whereItIs: Floating in the cytoplasm or clamped onto the rough ER.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the machine that turns genetic instructions into working proteins.

terms.definition: A small building-block molecule; proteins are chains of amino acids.
terms.function: The parts the ribosome links together to build a protein.
terms.whereItIs: Arriving at the ribosome from the cytoplasm.
terms.whyItMatters: The order of amino acids decides what each protein does.

terms.definition: A copy of a DNA instruction that carries the code out to the ribosome.
terms.function: Delivers the protein recipe to the building machine.
terms.whereItIs: Made in the nucleus, travels to the ribosome.
terms.whyItMatters: It lets instructions leave the nucleus without losing the master copy.
